title: ampelocissus compositifolia
intro: Ampelocissus compositifolia, commonly known as the Chinese grapevine or Himalayan grapevine, is a plant species in the family Vitaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and rheumatism. The therapeutic actions of Ampelocissus compositifolia are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been reported to possess antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities.
